dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Oh no. Where did I go wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: A victory, just as I expected.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: How could I make such a stupid mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It's pretty much what I expected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your research coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Not too bad, although I haven't had the best of luck recently... My clock is a few minutes too slow, and thanks to that, a whole load of experiments have failed dismally...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: It's not much use for keeping time anymore, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: But after being used in so many alchemical experiments, it seems to have gained some understanding of the basic makeup and functional principles of the world... Maybe it's undergone some sort of miraculous transformation.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Why don't you take it? Maybe it'll come in handy in your adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You'll be fine, the procedure is actually very simple. If you're interested, I can show you the basics?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Much as one who uses a wind glider needs not understand how it was built in order to glide.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The process is mesmerizing to witness. I'm confident you'll be singing the praises of ancient civilizations and their ingenuity after you've tried it for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Hi there, are you also interested in alchemy?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: I am Timaeus, an alchemy scholar. You may not have heard my name before...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: But I bet you'll have heard the names Albedo and Sucrose before.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Albedo is nothing short of a genius in the field of alchemy. And his assistant, Sucrose, is extremely talented for her age.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: I'm a total amateur compared to them.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Albedo is an alchemy prodigy. A lot of people call him the Kreideprinz. He's the top alchemical talent in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: They say he's an outlander who just showed up in Mondstadt one day and was instantly taken on as Chief Alchemist by the Knights of Favonius. He's also Captain of the Investigation Team.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: His alchemical theory is refreshingly unbridled in comparison to conventional theories. In practice it all works out too.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: In his eyes, my work must seem like child's play... *sigh*

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Sucrose is Albedo's only assistant. She's so lucky to have gained Albedo's appreciation.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: As a born and bred child of Mondstadt, we should all be proud of Sucrose's contributions to alchemy.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: But her research and interests are a little... antiquated, to the point that they rarely render any practical application.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: *sigh* If I had access to such a plethora of resources, who knows what I could accomplish.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alchemy?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Alchemy is a craft that has been passed down since ancient times, but it is barely understood in the present.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Its mechanisms are magical and mysterious, completely unlike the principles that shape our understanding of the physical world.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: If I can get the hang of it, I should be able to create some pretty awesome stuff, and contribute to our knowledge of ancient civilization.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Bye then, I'll carry on with my research.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Craft

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Ready to experience the greatness of alchemy at your very own hands? I'll be here to guide you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to use the Crafting Bench.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Sure, please go ahead.
